topic: audible announces ai-powered features for stories
headline_marked: Audible launches [[AI-powered character guides]] and interactive stories
headline: Audible launches AI-powered character guides and interactive stories
summary: Audible is integrating AI to offer character guides and interactive storytelling experiences, aiming to deepen listener engagement with audiobooks.
details: Audible has announced three new features designed to enhance the listening experience. These include AI-powered character guides, which provide deeper insights into the characters of a story, and interactive stories that allow listeners to influence the narrative.

The interactive story feature, currently in beta, allows users to speak with characters using voice replica technology. For example, a "Dracula: Renfield on the Run" interactive story lets users talk with Renfield, with their responses shaping the AI-generated dialogue.

These AI features aim to create a more immersive and personalized connection between listeners and the audio content. By allowing direct interaction and providing contextual information, Audible seeks to move beyond passive listening.

The platform is also introducing enhanced note-taking and clip-sharing functionalities, further encouraging listeners to engage with and remember key moments from their audiobooks. These updates are rolling out to users now.

headline_marked: [[ChatGPT]] launches virtual try-on for clothes and accessories
headline: ChatGPT launches virtual try-on for clothes and accessories
summary: OpenAI's AI assistant can now let you virtually try on clothing using your own photos, leveraging the new ChatGPT Images 2.5 model for realistic results.
details: OpenAI has rolled out two new shopping features for ChatGPT: a virtual try-on for clothing and accessories, and a favorites function to save desired items.

The virtual try-on feature allows users to upload a selfie or full-body photo to see how an item would look on them. Alternatively, users can provide a screenshot of an item and ask ChatGPT to visualize it.
This new capability is powered by the recently released ChatGPT Images 2.5 model, which boasts improved natural lighting, richer textures, better editing instruction adherence, and reduced latency.

Users can also describe a desired style and ask ChatGPT to find the necessary pieces, or upload celebrity outfit photos to find similar purchasable items, entering the fashion discovery space previously dominated by Pinterest and Google.
The Favorites feature allows users to save products to a Library within the app, alongside their virtual try-on images, for easy future reference.
This move into AI-powered shopping follows OpenAI's previous experiments, including an instant checkout feature that did not perform as well, and aims to enhance the online shopping experience.
